name: merchant-bot
description: A complete Telegram merchant marketplace bot (buyers, sellers, orders, admin) built with Node.js, Telegraf, Prisma and SQLite.

scripts.smoke: sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="file:./smoke.db" npx prisma db push --skip-generate >/dev/null 2>&1 && DATABASE_URL="file:./smoke.db" node tests/smoke.js; rm -f prisma/smoke.db prisma/smoke.db-journal'
scripts.e2e: sh -c 'DATABASE_URL="file:./e2e.db" npx prisma db push --skip-generate >/dev/null 2>&1 && DATABASE_URL="file:./e2e.db" node tests/e2e.js; rm -f prisma/e2e.db prisma/e2e.db-journal'
